Mission success rate: up to 97%

scenes.headline: Occupational hazard: bee-eaters.
scenes.body: A European bee-eater with an emperor dragonfly. Absurd pilot, very real food chain.

caption:
Meet the meadow's most decorated pilot.

Dragonflies eat mosquitoes and flies, and sometimes tackle prey weighing 60% of their own body weight.

Source: Combes et al. 2013; Britannica (Dragonfly).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: AI fighter-pilot parody where the absurd character carries real data (capture success, a real species named 'corporal'); AI clips labelled, real photos stand in.
